title: Reality, Enhanced by Animation
content: Storyboard artistMarty Cooper, also known as Hombre McSteez, had a viral hit on his hands this week with his compilation ofshort videos that he made for Instagram. In each one, he holds up drawings made on transparent cels in front of a background environment. The apparent interaction makes them hilarious.Marty works for ReelFX and is a member of theShrunkenHeadman Clubof San Jose State University.Thanks to everyone who recommended this.(Direct link to video)
